Class ShadowSatelliteManager

java.lang.Object
org.robolectric.shadows.ShadowSatelliteManager
@Implements(value=SatelliteManager.class, minSdk=35, isInAndroidSdk=false) public class ShadowSatelliteManager extends Object
Shadow for SatelliteManager system service.

    • registerStateChangeListener

      @Implementation(minSdk=36) protected void registerStateChangeListener(Executor executor, SatelliteStateChangeListener listener)
      Registers a SatelliteStateChangeListener to be notified of satellite state changes.

      Tests can mutate state via setEnabledState(boolean). If state has already been set at least once, this function also immediately dispatches a callback with that sticky value.
